boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, documentable destinations on Riverdale corridors around Manhattan University, each with a directly supported reason to stop.

cards.title: Van Cortlandt Park
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor
cards.notes: Enter from the Broadway edge to use the park’s mapped natural-area network; NYC Parks lists forest, grassland, freshwater wetland, trails, and water access.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway-side gateway to a large public park landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Van Cortlandt Park’s natural area along Broadway and identifies trails, forest, grassland, freshwater wetland, and water access.
cards.access_notes: Use official NYC Parks information to select an appropriate entrance and observe posted park rules.

cards.title: Riverdale Library
cards.subtitle: Mosholu Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Bring a reading list or laptop to the branch at 5540 Mosholu Avenue; NYPL documents books, Wi-Fi, computers, classes, and programs for all ages.
cards.short_summary: A Mosholu Avenue library branch with study-oriented services.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL locates Riverdale Library at 5540 Mosholu Avenue and states that branches offer books, Wi-Fi, computers, classes, and programs.
cards.source_title: New York Public Library: Riverdale Library
cards.access_notes: Check NYPL’s current branch page for open hours and program listings before visiting.

cards.title: Wave Hill
cards.subtitle: Independence Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a garden-and-gallery visit at the public garden and cultural center at 4900 Independence Avenue; Thursday general admission is listed as free.
cards.short_summary: A documented garden and cultural-center stop on Independence Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Wave Hill identifies itself as a public garden and cultural center at 4900 Independence Avenue and lists free general admission on Thursdays.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are listed as Tuesday–Sunday; confirm seasonal hours and special-event pricing before going.

cards.title: Riverdale Park
cards.subtitle: Palisade Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Palisade Avenue side for a documented trail outing; NYC Parks places this natural area between West 246th and West 254th Streets.
cards.short_summary: A Palisade Avenue natural area with listed trails.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks identifies Riverdale Park natural area at Hudson River, West 254th Street, Palisade Avenue, and West 246th Street, and lists trails.
cards.access_notes: Follow marked trails and posted NYC Parks guidance; conditions can vary with weather.

cards.title: Raoul Wallenberg Forest
cards.subtitle: Palisade Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Look for the named forest between West 235th and West 237th Streets; NYC Parks lists trails, forest, and grassland at this destination.
cards.short_summary: A named Palisade Avenue forest destination with trails.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks locates Raoul Wallenberg Forest on Palisade Avenue and Douglas Avenue between West 235th and West 237th Streets and lists trails, forest, and grassland.
cards.access_notes: Use marked paths and observe posted NYC Parks rules.

cards.title: Spuyten Duyvil Shorefront Park
cards.subtitle: Palisade Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Make this a short nature stop at the Palisade, Johnson, and Edsall avenue triangle; NYC Parks lists trails, forest, and grassland here.
cards.short_summary: A named shorefront natural area reached from the Palisade Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks identifies Spuyten Duyvil Shorefront Park natural area at Palisade Avenue, Johnson Avenue, and Edsall Avenue and lists trails, forest, and grassland.
cards.access_notes: Stay on formal trails and review posted park information before visiting.

cards.title: Spuyten Duyvil Library
cards.subtitle: West 235th Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the NYPL branch at 650 West 235th Street as a reading or research stop; the library’s official page documents its Riverdale location and accessibility features.
cards.short_summary: A named NYPL branch on West 235th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies Spuyten Duyvil Library at 650 West 235th Street in Riverdale and states that most of the one-story branch is wheelchair accessible.
cards.source_title: New York Public Library: About the Spuyten Duyvil Library
cards.access_notes: Consult NYPL’s location page for current open hours and available services.

cards.title: Van Cortlandt House Museum
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor in Van Cortlandt Park
cards.notes: Pair a Broadway-side park visit with the named historic house museum; NYC Parks lists the museum among Van Cortlandt Park’s visitor contacts.
cards.short_summary: A named historic-house museum within the Broadway-edge park.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Van Cortlandt House Museum as a Van Cortlandt Park contact and provides its visitor telephone number.
cards.source_title: NYC Parks: Van Cortlandt Park Highlights—Kelly Fields
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s official visitor information for current tour and admission details.

cards.title: Van Cortlandt Park–242 St Station
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor at West 242nd Street
cards.notes: Use this named northern terminal as a transit waypoint for the Broadway corridor; Wave Hill’s directions identify it as the last northbound stop on the 1 line.
cards.short_summary: A named Broadway transit stop that anchors the western park edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Wave Hill’s official directions identify Van Cortlandt Park/West 242nd Street as the last northbound stop on the 1 subway line.
cards.access_notes: Review MTA service notices before relying on a specific train trip.

cards.title: Kelly Fields
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor in northwest Van Cortlandt Park
cards.notes: Bring a ballgame or spectator plan to this named park destination; NYC Parks documents two baseball diamonds, drinking fountains, bleachers, and benches.
cards.short_summary: A named Northwest Van Cortlandt Park field complex.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks states that Kelly Fields has two baseball diamonds, drinking fountains, bleachers, and benches in northwest Van Cortlandt Park.
cards.source_title: NYC Parks: Van Cortlandt Park Highlights—Kelly Fields
cards.access_notes: Field availability and organized use can change; check NYC Parks information before planning play.
